category.name: 3D generation and assets
category.description: Text/image-to-3D mesh generation, texturing and 3D asset libraries.

entries.name: Hyper3D Rodin API
entries.free_tier: Paid only: API access requires the Business plan ($120/mo, $96/mo billed annually) or Enterprise; direct credits $1.5 each
entries.desc_en: Generate 3D meshes from text or images (sketch/regular/detail quality tiers) via an async REST job API.
entries.notes: Async task-based API: submit generation, then poll or use webhooks to retrieve the finished asset.

async_jobs.how: POST /rodin returns uuid + jobs.subscription_key; poll POST /status, then POST /download with task_uuid

call.async: Poll POST https://api.hyper3d.com/api/v2/status with {"subscription_key": jobs.subscription_key} until every job is Done, then POST https://api.hyper3d.com/api/v2/download with {"task_uuid": uuid} to get list[].url.

uptime.up_means: host reachable: HTTP < 500, even 401/404; not a test of any endpoint

entries.name: Meshy API
entries.free_tier: Paid only: creating API keys requires a paid plan (Pro $20/mo+); Free accounts get only a built-in test key for the Playground (free web plan 100 credits/mo)
entries.desc_en: Generate, retexture, rig, and animate 3D models from text or images via REST API or official MCP server.
entries.notes: Free web accounts get only a limited built-in Playground key; creating/managing your own API keys requires a paid subscription. Text-to-3D is on /openapi/v2/text-to-3d (other endpoints stay on /openapi/v1).

rate_limits.summary: 20 requests/s on Pro-Ultra (Enterprise 100); concurrent queue tasks 10 (Pro) to 100 (Ultra); 429 when exceeded

async_jobs.how: POST returns task id; poll GET task until SUCCEEDED, or use SSE streaming or webhooks

data_policy.summary: Generated files retained for 3 days on non-Enterprise plans

call.async: Returns 202 with `result` (task id). Poll GET https://api.meshy.ai/openapi/v2/text-to-3d/{id} (or stream GET .../{id}/stream) until status is SUCCEEDED; then read model_urls, thumbnail_url, texture_urls.

uptime.up_means: host reachable: HTTP < 500, even 401/404; not a test of any endpoint

entries.name: Sketchfab Data API
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Token <API_TOKEN> (personal token) or OAuth2 Authorization: Bearer <access_token>; legacy v2 endpoints are deprecated
entries.free_tier: Free: no key needed for search and model listing (GET /v3/search, /v3/models); downloads (/v3/models/{uid}/download) need a free account token
entries.desc_en: Search, download, and upload 3D models on Sketchfab programmatically via the REST Data API v3.
entries.notes: This is an asset hosting/marketplace API, not a generative AI model; downloading models generally requires an authenticated Sketchfab account (and often the uploader's permission/license). Use v3 endpoints; v2 is deprecated.

rate_limits.summary: Calls can be throttled to limit abuse; throttled clients get 429 Too Many Requests (no numeric limit published)

uptime.up_means: host reachable: HTTP < 500, even 401/404; not a test of any endpoint

entries.name: Stability AI 3D (Stable Fast 3D / SPAR3D) API
entries.free_tier: 25 free credits on signup, then pay-as-you-go (Stable Fast 3D costs 10 credits ~ $0.10/generation)
entries.desc_en: Convert a single 2D image into a textured 3D mesh (GLB) via the v2beta/3d REST endpoints.
entries.notes: Endpoints such as POST https://api.stability.ai/v2beta/3d/stable-fast-3d; part of Stability's broader multi-modal Platform API.

rate_limits.summary: 150 requests per 10 seconds; exceeding returns 429 and a 60-second timeout

async_jobs.how: POST /v2beta/3d/stable-fast-3d and /v2beta/3d/stable-point-aware-3d return the GLB binary directly

call.operation: convert one image into a 3D GLB model

uptime.up_means: host reachable: HTTP < 500, even 401/404; not a test of any endpoint

entries.name: Tencent Hunyuan3D API
entries.auth_hint: Tencent Cloud SecretId/SecretKey, TC3-HMAC-SHA256 signed requests via the Tencent Cloud API/SDK
entries.free_tier: Trial: 200 free credits one-time on first activation (valid 1 year); then postpaid $0.02/credit, Professional generation 25 credits (~$0.50), Express 15
entries.desc_en: Generate textured 3D meshes (GLB, PBR) from text, images, or sketches via Tencent Cloud's Hunyuan 3D API.
entries.notes: 3d.hunyuan.tencent.com is the consumer web app; programmatic access requires a Tencent Cloud account and the Tencent Cloud API console, not the consumer site directly. An open-source self-hostable model (Hunyuan3D-2.1) is also available on GitHub for those who don't want the managed cloud API.

free_plan.quota: 200 credits per user (one-time free resource package on first activation, valid 1 year)

auth_scheme.format: Tencent Cloud API 3.0 signature (TC3-HMAC-SHA256) with SecretId/SecretKey; X-TC-Action: SubmitHunyuanTo3DProJob

rate_limits.summary: SubmitHunyuanTo3DProJob: max 20 requests/s; 3 concurrent tasks by default

call.example: curl -X POST https://hunyuan.intl.tencentcloudapi.com/ -H "Authorization: $TC3_AUTHORIZATION" -H "Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8" -H "X-TC-Action: SubmitHunyuanTo3DProJob" -H "X-TC-Version: 2023-09-01" -H "X-TC-Timestamp: $TIMESTAMP" -H "X-TC-Region: $TC_REGION" -d '{"Prompt":"cat"}'
call.async: poll action QueryHunyuanTo3DProJob with {"JobId":...} until Status is DONE, then read ResultFile3Ds[].Url (https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1284/75541). $TC3_AUTHORIZATION is a TC3-HMAC-SHA256 signature computed per request from SecretId/SecretKey

unit_price.summary: Pro job 25 credits (LowPoly 30, +10 with PBR), Rapid 15 credits; postpaid $0.02 per credit, so a Pro job is $0.50

uptime.up_means: host reachable: HTTP < 500, even 401/404; not a test of any endpoint

entries.name: Tripo API
entries.free_tier: Trial: one-time free credits on first API key (amount varies by signup path, not listed on the pricing page); then pay-as-you-go at $0.01/credit
entries.desc_en: Generate textured 3D meshes from text or images via REST API, with an official MCP server for agents.
entries.notes: Maintained by VAST AI Research (Tripo's developer). Free-credit amounts vary by promotion. The MCP server is alpha (last commit 2025-04) and needs Blender with the Tripo addon.

rate_limits.summary: Per-key rate limits (X-RateLimit-* headers, 429); default 10 concurrent tasks per category (image gen 1, P-series 5)

call.async: Poll GET https://openapi.tripo3d.ai/v3/tasks/{task_id} until data.status is 'success', then download data.output.model_url (webhooks also available)
call.example: curl -X POST https://openapi.tripo3d.ai/v3/generation/text-to-model -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TRIPO_API_KEY" -d '{"prompt": "a cute cat", "model": "v3.1-20260211"}'

uptime.up_means: host reachable: HTTP < 500, even 401/404; not a test of any endpoint
